content: We applied the identifier in a two-step approach. In the first run we allowed the identifier to output all 55 languages that it supports out of the box, plus Romansh, the fourth official language in Switzerland. We found that no Romansh comments were detected and that all unexpected outputs were misclassifications of German, French or Italian comments. We further concluded that little or no Swiss German comments are in the dataset: If they were, some of them would have manifested themselves in the form of misclassifications (e.g. as Dutch).
